preconditions.description: The input text must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in '12345' or c in text for c in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output string consists of characters from the input string, except lowercase vowels which are replaced by their corresponding digits.

postconditions.expression: return_value == ''.join('1' if c == 'a' else '2' if c == 'e' else '3' if c == 'i' else '4' if c == 'o' else '5' if c == 'u' else c for c in text)
postconditions.description: Each lowercase vowel in the input is replaced by its specific digit mapping (a->1, e->2, i->3, o->4, u->5), and all other characters remain unchanged in their original order.
